name: Road Love Story
original_name: ロードラブストーリー
source:
Ryo Uehara was on summer vacations when the elementary school girl living next door rang the doorbell. She explained with tears that before the summer vacations she had a quarrel with boy  Yura Yuta and then he changed schools so they could not properly make it up. 
Hero takes boy's photo and jumps into a bus to begin his search.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
上原亮正在放暑假，隔壁的小学女生按响了门铃。她泪流满面地解释说，暑假前她和男孩由良雄太吵架了，后来他转学了，所以他们无法好好和好。
希罗拍下了男孩的照片，然后跳上公共汽车开始他的搜索。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
